method: Manually selected original-action and earlier-source identity labels from 133 action descriptions; differentiated same described action, subcomponent, regional or dated variants, and false lexical hits. Each action remains a source component, and 'same' is NOT confirmation that historical practices were independently described by two primary witnesses. Older original book pages for both sides were not directly compared in facsimile, hence no final canonical merger.

records.source_description: Mark a family Paschal candle with five cloves in cross form
records.compared_prior_description: Insert five cloves into a home Paschal candle as a devotional image
records.reason: Both describe fitting five cloves into a family Paschal candle; source dependence and exact construction differ or remain unknown.

records.source_description: Give Easter eggs decorated in red or gold with Resurrection symbols
records.compared_prior_description: Easter eggs decorated with Resurrection symbols
records.reason: Both describe decorating Easter eggs with specifically Christian Resurrection symbols; color or application details vary.

records.source_description: Make an Easter Wreath of Victory from laurel and flowers
records.compared_prior_description: Christmas laurel wreath with victory symbolism
records.reason: A laurel Easter victory wreath is not the described Christmas laurel wreath, even if the materials and victory language resemble each other.

records.source_description: Renew baptismal vows together as a family at Easter dinner
records.compared_prior_description: Renew baptismal vows collectively before Easter
records.reason: Both report a family renewal of baptismal vows during the Easter period; one specifically places it at dinner and the other before Easter.

records.source_description: Renew baptismal vows together as a family at Easter dinner
records.compared_prior_description: Renew baptismal vows at the home altar on the baptism anniversary
records.reason: The Kelly rite is a baptism-anniversary family home-altar observance, rather than the fixed Easter family dinner renewal.

records.source_description: Paint Easter eggs with a victory banner or Chi-Rho emblem
records.compared_prior_description: Paint Easter eggs with crosses and other symbols of Christ's victory
records.reason: Painting Easter eggs with a Cross or Chi-Rho is a more specific variant of Christian victory motifs described in the earlier Mueller action.

records.source_description: Retain a lantern of fire from the Holy Saturday Vigil for household devotion
records.compared_prior_description: Taking home Easter Vigil blessed fire by lantern
records.reason: Both report carrying the newly blessed Easter fire away from the Vigil by lantern to the home; distinct source independence unverified.

records.source_description: Set a carved white dove above the Pentecost altar decorations
records.compared_prior_description: Pentecost altar decorated in red with dove
records.reason: Both describe a home Pentecost devotional altar including a dove, with the later source specifying a carved white image.

records.source_description: Arrange seven roses on the Pentecost family table to teach the gifts of the Spirit
records.compared_prior_description: Arrange a paper tableau with dove seven gifts and cosmos symbols for Pentecost
records.reason: Seven red roses on the Pentecost table differ from a paper tableau displaying the seven gifts, though both teach those gifts.

records.source_description: Visit local cemetery with flowers on All Souls and care for family graves
records.compared_prior_description: Cleaning and decorating graves before All Souls
records.reason: All Souls cemetery visits with flowers and maintaining relatives' graves overlap cleaning/decorating graves, but visiting and tending are separable actions.

records.source_description: Add a handful of earth to a coffin after marking a cross over it
records.compared_prior_description: Louisiana funeral attendees cast earth on coffin
records.reason: Casting earth upon a coffin overlaps the reported Louisiana funeral action, but the first book's geographic context is different or incompletely resolved.

records.source_description: Slovak organists bake Christmas oblatky wafers for parish households
records.compared_prior_description: Slovak honeyed Christmas oblatky distributed
records.reason: Both describe Slovak Christmas oblatky distribution to families; the Family Life Bureau report specifies organists and one per household member.

records.source_description: Keep a special Christ candle at family meals through the twelve days of Christmas
records.compared_prior_description: Some families light central Christ candle each of twelve Christmas days
records.reason: A central Christ candle lit during the twelve days at family meals is the same described household action type, with independent borrowing unassessed.

records.source_description: Louisiana families clean and whitewash cemetery tombs before All Saints
records.compared_prior_description: Louisiana French clean and flower graves before All Saints
records.reason: Both report Louisiana households cleaning or decorating family graves for All Saints; source independence of the two publications unknown.

records.source_description: Obtain newly blessed Easter water for use in family Easter prayers
records.compared_prior_description: Carry newly blessed Easter water home in a specially decorated bottle
records.reason: Both involve obtaining newly blessed Easter water from church and taking it home; Mueller specifies the vessel decoration.

records.source_description: Sing Regina Caeli as an Easter family hymn and seasonal devotion
records.compared_prior_description: Recite the Easter Sequence and Regina Coeli as domestic Easter devotion
records.reason: Both place Regina Caeli in the household Easter devotional setting, while Mueller also includes the Easter sequence.

records.source_description: Decorate the home Cenacle with red roses for Pentecost
records.compared_prior_description: Decorate the Pentecost devotional setting with red roses
records.reason: Both describe displaying red roses at a household Pentecost devotional setting; model Cenacle is an optional component.

records.source_description: Ukrainian pysanky eggs carry wax-resist Easter symbolic ornamentation
records.compared_prior_description: Decorating Easter eggs: pisanki and pysanky
records.reason: Ukrainian pysanky wax-resist decoration fits the candidate Easter-egg craft family, but no canonical identity or exhaustive variant scope is proven.

records.source_description: Read and discuss the next day's Sunday Mass texts on Saturday evening
records.compared_prior_description: Study the next day's Lenten Mass text in the evening before attending Mass
records.reason: Reading the next day's Mass texts before Sunday is a wider Saturday practice than reading next day's Lenten propers.

records.source_description: Wear mourning dress varying by closeness of kinship
records.compared_prior_description: Women penitents wear mourning black with a lace mantilla
records.reason: Kinship-based mourning clothes of a family bereavement are different from the black costume of Roussillon penitential-procession participants.

records.source_description: A 1956 source repeats an unverified story about St Patrick and Tara fire rite
records.compared_prior_description: Conduct a household tree blessing described in the source, with formula authority unverified
records.reason: The unverified St Patrick Tara fire legend does not attest a household Christmas-tree blessing formula.

records.source_description: Frame hand-painted Easter window pictures with colored construction paper
records.compared_prior_description: Frame the painted signs with dotted border marks
records.reason: Framing children's painted Easter window images does not attest the painted sign-border marks of a Portuguese seasonal practice.

records.source_description: Display a photograph and holy image in glass-framed grave memorial boxes
records.compared_prior_description: Historical decorated glass reliquary display
records.reason: Grave memorial boxes carrying a photograph and holy image are not decorated glass reliquaries containing relic-related objects.

records.source_description: Parish organists visit homes distributing one oblatka per family member before Christmas
records.compared_prior_description: Describe the parish's Epiphany house-blessing performed in four directions from church or tower where homes are too numerous to visit
records.reason: The house-to-house Christmas oblatky distribution by Slovak organists differs from a parish-wide Epiphany blessing oriented toward homes.

records.source_description: Bring freshly blessed Easter water home for family devotions
records.compared_prior_description: Families bring blessed Epiphany water home for day of feast
records.reason: Both bring blessed water home, but Easter Vigil water differs in season and source ritual context from Epiphany water.

records.source_description: Lead a priestly cemetery procession on November 1 before blessing graves
records.compared_prior_description: Priestly grave blessing on All Souls
records.reason: Priestly grave blessings during Louisiana's All Saints cemetery event and All Souls blessing are related but may have different date and locale.

records.source_description: Light preserved baptismal candles at the Easter family table
records.compared_prior_description: Hold blessed candles during a home renewal of baptismal promises
records.reason: Lighting baptismal candles at Easter dinner may accompany a household renewal of baptismal promises, but holding candles for the renewal is a different gesture.

records.source_description: Adapt child's dolls into figures for a homemade Bethlehem crib
records.compared_prior_description: Creating domestic Nativity figures and personalized crib banners
records.reason: Using children's dolls for a Nativity home-crib figure is a proposed variant within the broader making and personalizing Nativity figures.

records.source_description: Design and construct a home Nativity crib with children's assistance
records.compared_prior_description: Creating domestic Nativity figures and personalized crib banners
records.reason: Constructing a domestic crib is broader than making individual figurines or personalized banners; do not treat all the components as the same individual custom.

records.source_description: Use Ascension crown Pentecost dove and Trinity triangle on a symbolic triptych
records.compared_prior_description: Eye-in-triangle Trinity images in homes and roadside shrines
records.reason: A Trinity triangle on a family Ascension-Pentecost triptych differs from an eye-in-triangle image displayed in homes and roadside shrines.

records.source_description: Fasten a white triumph ribbon bearing an Alleluia emblem to the Easter cross
records.compared_prior_description: St Patrick's ribbon cross
records.reason: White triumph ribbon on a family's Easter Cross of Victory is not the St Patrick's ribbon cross tradition.

records.source_description: Poor guests receive prayers and practical hospitality in Irish homes
records.compared_prior_description: Irish Christmas light in window historically associated with hospitality
records.reason: Hospitality toward poor visitors in an Irish home and Christmas-window light symbolism express related ideals but are different primary actions.

records.source_description: Serve Easter bread cake eggs and lamb as festive family foods
records.compared_prior_description: Serve blessed Easter foods at the festive family breakfast
records.reason: Serving an Easter menu of bread cake eggs and lamb may overlap blessed Easter breakfast foods, but the blessing and meal menu remain separate.

records.source_description: Request a priestly blessing of food or use a clearly distinct domestic meal prayer
records.compared_prior_description: Domestic crib blessing using family responses and a proposed prayer text
records.reason: A request to bless Easter food or say household table grace is not the family blessing of a domestic Nativity crib.

records.source_description: Make a cardboard Cenacle representing the apostles' upper room
records.compared_prior_description: Make Nativity figures from cardboard cutouts
records.reason: A cardboard Pentecost Cenacle depicting apostles is different from cardboard Nativity figures for a Christmas crib.

records.source_description: Different household groups take turns praying the Rosary during a wake
records.compared_prior_description: Take turns praying before the reserved Sacrament at the altar of repose
records.reason: Family Rosary turns during a wake differ from adoration prayer before the reserved Sacrament at the Holy Thursday altar of repose.

records.source_description: Hold an overnight cemetery prayer vigil when priest unavailable
records.compared_prior_description: Pray an adapted family Tenebrae devotion when church service is unavailable
records.reason: An All Souls overnight cemetery vigil is not an adapted domestic Tenebrae service in Holy Week.

records.source_description: Decorate an Easter altar hanging with a Lumen Christi symbol
records.compared_prior_description: Hanging blessed Corpus Christi wreaths at home or by fields
records.reason: An Easter home-altar hanging bearing Lumen Christi is not a blessed Corpus Christi wreath hung at houses or fields.

records.source_description: Request memorial Masses on anniversaries of a relative's death
records.compared_prior_description: Use some Epiphany alms to request Masses for deceased souls
records.reason: Anniversary memorial Mass requests and using Epiphany charitable alms to request Masses both support prayer for dead but involve different occasions and transactions.

records.source_description: Keep a special Christ candle at family meals through the twelve days of Christmas
records.compared_prior_description: Family places Christmas Christ candle at dinner table for meals
records.reason: Both describe placing a family Christ candle at Christmas-season dinner meals, not a distinct second ceremony for each author's sentence.

records.source_description: Prepare Easter spice-ring cake around the family's devotional candle
records.compared_prior_description: New Easter fire carried home in lantern
records.reason: An Easter fire carried home from a church Vigil is reported in both books, but the McLoughlin text has a material and devotional-specific context.
